additional_modbus_timeout: Add this value (in seconds) to the modbus timeout value. Floating point value.
additionalrunhours: Nexus controllers (not Evolution) do not have the ability to set the run hours. If your controller has been replaced you can use this entry to add hours to the Run Hours reported by the in the UI. Note: If this option is used it will only modify the run hours displayed in the web interface. It will not affect the controllers internal maintenance counters. This value must be a numeric value.
address: The Modbus slave address in hexadecimal. This value is 9d for Evolution / Nexus, and typically 64 for industrial generators.
allow_local_access: If enabled, genmon will allow LAN access to the genmon socket interface. This setting is disabled by default if the web UI enabled authentication to increase the security of genmon. If you want to access genmon via the socket interface or run an add on on a different computer then enable this option.
alternate_date_format: Use dd/mm/yyyy for date format instead of mm/dd/yyyy where applicable
controllertype: Set to h_100 for H-100 mode or powerzone for PowerZone or custom to use an imported controller configuration, otherwise the software will default to Nexus/Evolution Mode
currentdivider: This is a value to override the divisor used to calculate the current for Evolution units. This value is expressed in floating point. Leave blank to use the default value.
currentoffset: This value provides an offset to compensate for mis-calibrated current transformers in Evolution generators. This may need to be used if you you see a negative current value displayed for Evolution Air Cooled Generators. The default value is zero. Leave blank to use the default value.
disableplatformstats: If enabled, platform statistics will not be displayed in the user interface
enable_fuel_log: If enabled, the fuel level will be logged to a file periodically if the fuel level changes. The default filename is /etc/genmon/fuellog.txt
estimated_load: The percent load (expresses a a decimal value i.e. .5 = 50 percent) used when estimating the run hours left until the tank is empty.
extend_wait: Number of additional seconds to wait to retry sending failed emails.
forceserialuse: Force Use of Serial Port on Errors
If enabled, the software will try continue attempt use the serial port even if it is not found when the software is initially loaded. This may be needed for some serial USB devices.
fuel_log_freq: The frequency in minutes to log the fuel level to a file.
fuel_units: The unit of the Half and Full consumption rate. Use this fuel consumption stats for non Evolution units or to override the fuel consumption defaults for Evolution controllers.
full_rate: The number of units of fuel consumed by your generator at a full load. Use this fuel consumption stats for non Evolution units or to override the fuel consumption defaults for Evolution controllers.
half_rate: The unit of fuel for Half and Full Rate parameters. Use this fuel consumption stats for non Evolution units or to override the fuel consumption defaults for Evolution controllers.
https_port: Port to override the secure web server port (https). The default value is 443.
ignore_unknown: Ignore unknown values for modbus register 0001 for Evolution 2.0
import_config_file: Only used for custom controller type. Select the controller configuration to use for the custom controller type. See the project wiki for more info on custom controller support
kwlogmax: Override the maximum size of the kW log. The default is 15MB.
legacy_power: If enabled this will allow the use of the older method to calculate current / power for Evolution Air Cooled controllers
login_lockout_seconds: The number of seconds to perform a lockout if failed logins exceed Maximum Login Attempts. For example if this value is 300 seconds (5 min) and max attempt is 5, then if 5 logins failures occur in a row within 5 minutes, the a lockout will occur for 5 minutes.
loglocation: Location of log files. Full path must be specified.
max_login_attempts: Maxmum login attempts before temporary lockout

The maximum number of failed login attempts to the web interface before a temporary lockout is started. A lockout will prevent any login attempts. If the login failures occur within the time frame of lockout duration then then logins will be blocked for the number of seconds of lockout duration. Set to zero to disable.
max_powerlog_entries: The maximum number of entries in the working power log. Note the log file will not be truncated until the maximum file size is reached. In most cases the default is the preferred value.
min_outage_duration: Outages less than this time in seconds will not be logged. Notifications will still be sent if enabled.
modbus_between_frame_delay: This value will add a delay between modbus requests. For most controllers this value should be zero (disabled). This is a floating point value. To add a 10 mS delay use the value 0.01. Values above 0.2 may cause very slow performance.
multi_instance: If Enabled this setting will allow multiple instances of genmon to be used on one system. Note that other settings will also need to be changed. See the wiki for additional details.
nominallinevolts: Override nominal line voltage in UI
Override nominal line voltage value for UI (i.e. 220, 230 in stead of 240)
outage_notice_delay: The delay in seconds between a detected loss in utility voltage and a notification of an outage. This value must be an integer.
outage_notice_interval: To enable recurring outage notices set this to a positive non zero integer value. This represents the number of minutes to send a recurring outage notice.
outagelog_max_entries: The maximimum number of entries allowed in the outage log. You may increase this value from the default of 100 however if you notice a drop in the web UI performance you should reduce this back to the default value.
phase: Set the phase of the controller for genmon's use. This value is used only by genmon. It does not set the phase of the controller, but tells genmon the phase of the generator (e.g. 1 for single phase, 3 for three phase). For most controllers this value is ignored, however some custom config based controllers, like MEBAY can set this value based on the controller configuration.
preferred_network_adapter: If genmon failes to identify your network adapter correctly in cases where multiple adapaters are present, set this value to the adapater name that you would like genmon to report as the active network device. Note: only WLAN adapters display statistics.
response_address: Only used for Pre Nexus 2008 Generac controllers. Should be 41 if Pre-Nexus controller is present.
serial_parity: The default for Generac is None. Some (Briggs and Stratton uses Odd) custom controllers may use Odd or Even parity. Note: this is only for direct serial, not for serial over TCP.
serial_rate: The rate of the serial link used to communicate with the controller. In almost all cases this is 9600. Evolution 4.5L models may use 115200 for this value.
serialnumberifmissing: If the serial number is not present due to the controller being replaced you can override the missing serial number and still have the software lookup model information. This is a numeric value that must be ten digits. Pad leading zeros if you serial number is less than 10 digits.
server_port: The TCP port used internally by genmon for communicating with the supporting applications. Some apps may not work without modification if this is changed.
show_hours_activation: Enable to show Time Since Activation as hours, disable to show as Years, Days, Hours
subtractfuel: The amount of fuel (gal or L, depending on 'Use Metric' setting) to subtract from the fuel in tank estimate
threephaseutilitycompensation: If enabled, the Utility Voltage will not be divided by 2 for three phase Evolution Air Cooled systems.
unbalanced_capacity: Disabled if zero. If non zero this will be the maximum allowable difference in the load on a generator leg, represented as a percent of the maximum load. A value of 0.50 (50%) would be an allowable difference of 100 amps between legs on a 200 amp rated generator. Lower values will be the most strict threshold. Higher values will be less strict. Valid values are 0 - 0.50. Unbalanced capacity notices are set via a warning email, once per day.
use_aux_alarm_log: If enabled the sotware will log alarms that occur while the software is running. This log is separate from any alarm logging internal to the controller.
uselinuxwifisignalgauge: if enabled and running linux the WiFi signal will be displayed on a gauge in the web interface. Note, the gauge will not show if you are using Ethernet for your network.
usenominallinevolts: Enable overriding of the default of 240V for nominal line voltage in the UI
user_url: A user defined URL link to include in status emails sent from the software when the generator status changes
useraspberrypicputempgauge: If enabled and running on a Linux system, the CPU temperature will be displayed on a gauge in the web interface.
userdatalocation: Location of user defined JSON data (userdefined.json) to be displayed on Monitor page. Full path must be specified.
wait_for_init_seconds: The time in seconds to delay waiting for genmon intilization to complete. Some USB serial ports may be slow to open and this can be increased from the default value for greater compatiblity. Note that increasing this value could also cause an increase the time before the web interface is available if you have comms issues.
watchdog_addition: Additional delay before a communication timeout notification
wifiispercent: Some Linux wifi drivers (like USB wifi adapters) may return a percentage instead of a raw signal strength. If your wifi gauge is not working as expected, try enabling this setting. Note, the built in raspberry pi driver returns signal strength, not percentage so if using the on board adapter this setting should be disabled.

allow_iframe: SECURITY RISK - keep this OFF unless you understand the risks. Off (default, recommended) blocks all iframe embedding for the web interface, which protects against clickjacking. Turning it On lets ANY website embed the genmon web page in an iframe, which can be abused to trick you into clicking controls. Only enable it if you are embedding genmon in your own trusted dashboard (e.g. Home Assistant) on a network you control.
autofeedback: If enabled, an email will be sent to the software maintainer if critical data is missing in the software for your generator. The email will contain the contents of the generator registers. Enabling this option helps support the widest possible set of features and supported generators.
cert_mode: Certificate mode for HTTPS. 'selfsigned' generates a temporary certificate on each restart (browser will show a warning). 'localca' creates a persistent local CA you can import into your browser for a trusted connection. 'custom' lets you supply your own certificate and key files.
certfile: Path and filename of the certificate file for your own certificate (cert_mode = custom).
disableimap: Enable incoming email. See the project wiki Tips and Trick page for info on setting up inbound email.
disableoutagecheck: If enabled and supported by the controller, this setting will disable the monitoring and notification of the utility line voltage for detecting power outages. If you have a 'smart' transfer switch, this may need to be enabled. For Evo/Nexus this is typically disabled. For Briggs an Stratton, if enabled this will disable the display of the Utility line information for off-grid mode.
disablepowerlog: Enable to disable the power log and current reading. Not supported on Nexus.
disablesensorlog: If enabled, the logging of sensor data will be disabled. This also disbles the graphs of sensors in the web interface.
disablesmtp: Enable outgoing email. See the project wiki Tips and Trick page for info on setting up outbound email.
disableweather: Enable the weather feature. Requires an OpenWeatherMap API key and location to be configured.
displayunknown: Display the contents of additional data that appear to be associated with an unknown modbus register or a calculated value not included with the default genmon data set.
email_pw: Password for the email account used for sending and receiving email
enhancedexercise: Enable the functionality to support biweekly and monthly exercise times (weekly is the default). Note, your generator controller must support this before enabling this option. Evolution only and firmware version dependent.
favicon: favicon for website. This is an optional parameter and default is "favicon.ico". This may not work in older browsers
fueltype: The type of fuel used by your generator (Natural Gas, Propane, Diesel, Gasoline). This value is used by for displaying the correct information to the user.
http_pass: Simple authentication will be used. Sets the password of the simple authentication. Leave blank to disable. 'Use Secure Web Settings' must be enabled to use this feature.
http_pass_ro: Sets the password of the limited rights user. Leave blank to disable. 'Use Secure Web Settings' and full rights user must be enabled to use this feature.
http_port: HTTP port to be used by the web server.
http_user: Simple authentication will be used. Sets the username of the simple authentication. Leave blank to disable. 'Use Secure Web Settings' must be enabled to use this feature.
http_user_ro: Sets the username of the limited rights user. Leave blank to disable. 'Use Secure Web Settings' and full rights user must be enabled to use this feature.
imap_server: Server address used for receiving email, leave empty to disable IMAP. See the project wiki Tips and Trick page for info on setting up inbound email.
incoming_mail_folder: The name of the folder in the mailbox for searching for incoming email commands
keyfile: Path and filename of the key file for your own certificate (cert_mode = custom).
max_sensorlog_entries: The maximum number of entries in each sensor log. Note the log file will not be truncated until the maximum file size is reached. In most cases the default is the preferred value.
metricweather: If enabled, metric units will be displayed when applicable.
mfa_trust_days: Days to remember (never use on shared computers)
mfa_trust_extend: Remember this browser & don't ask for MFA again
minimumweatherinfo: If enabled the minimum information regarding the weather will be displayed, otherwise the maximum info will be displayed
modbus_tcp: If enabled, the modbus TCP protocol will be used. If disabled modbus RTU (serial) over TCP is used.
nominalfrequency: Frequency your generator is running. Either 50Hz or 60Hz. This is used by the web interface.
nominalkw: The maximum kilowatt output of your generator. This is used by the web interface.
nominalrpm: The RPM of your generator. Typically 1800 or 3600 for 60Hz and 1500 or 3000 for 50Hz. Some models run at 2300. This is used by the web interface.
optimizeforslowercpu: If enabled, minor optimizations for slower CPUs will be used. Note that this is a design trade off for responsiveness vs CPU utilization.
port: Serial device name of your serial port. Normally  /dev/serial0 or /dev/ttyAMA0 for onboard Raspberry Pi Serial ports
processed_mail_folder: Once an email command has been processed by the software the email is moved to this mailbox folder
readonlyemailcommands: If enabled, email commands that write to the controller will be disabled (settime, setexercise, setremote, etc.)
remember_me_days: Number of days the browser remembers your login when you check "Remember me". Set to 0 for a browser-session only — your login expires as soon as you close the browser.
sender_account: Email address from which the emails are sent, can be blank if Email Account is a valid address.
sender_name: Name of the sender (i.e. Genmon or John Doe)
sensorlogmax: Override the maximum size of each sensor log. The default is 5MB.
serial_tcp_address: If Serial over TCP/IP is enabled, this parameter sets the IP address (or fully qualified domain name) used for the serial server.
serial_tcp_keepalive: If enabled, the TCP connection will set the keep alive flag within the TCP protocol.
serial_tcp_port: If Serial over TCP/IP is enabled, this parameter sets the IP port used for the serial server.
smart_transfer_switch: If enabled a smart transfer switch is utilized and the generator controller will not be responsible for starting and stopping or or weekly exercise functions and these items will be disabled in the web interface.
smtp_port: SMTP port used on the SMTP server for sending email. Typically port 587 is used for TLS and port 465 is used for SSL
smtp_server: Mail server used for sending email, leave empty to disable SMTP. See the project wiki Tips and Trick page for info on setting up outbound email.
smtpauth_disable: If enabled, ignore SMTP authentication. Typically only used for locally administered SMTP servers
ssl_enabled: Use SSL encryption to send emails
syncdst: Enable to sync the generator time to the system time if there is a change in Daylight Savings Time. This does not change the system time, only the generator time.
synctime: Enables syncing the generator time to the system time once every hour. This does not change the system time, only the generator time.
system_theme: Select light or dark theme based on the browser/system setting
Use the browser-provided light/dark theme setting in the UI, and remove the manual theme switcher. This may not work in older brwsers
tanksize: Fuel tank size. Units is gallons unless "Use Metric Units" is enabled, then it is in liters. This is used to estimate the fuel remaining the tank. Ignore for Natural Gas or tankless installations. If external tank sensors are used via an add on then this setting can be used if all tanks are the same size, then set this to the the total capacity of all tanks (sum of all tanks size).
tls_disable: If SSL is disabled TLS encryption is the default, unless this is enabled. If enabled and SSL is disabled, no encryption will be used to send email.
update_check: If enabled the software will send an email notice when a software update is available.
use_html: Send a structured HTML alternative (in addition to plain text) so screen readers get clear pauses between status lines.
use_serial_tcp: If enabled, the software will use TCP over serial instead of direct serial communications
usehttps: HTTPS (secure HTTP) and / or user name and password authentication.
usemfa: Use Multi-Factor Authentication. You must use a Multi-Factor Authenticator app like Google Authenticator or Authy to use this feature. If enabled, MFA will apply to both normal and limited rights login.
weatherkey: Openweathermap.org API Key. This is required to enable weather reporting. See https://openweathermap.org/appid. Requires openweathermap library. If you installed the Generator Monitor Software before V1.9.6 and are upgrading you must run this command: "sudo pip install pyowm" from the console before the weather features will be functional
weatherlocation: The location to report weather. Either enter City,State,Country or a openweathermap.org city ID. Automatic lookup of location requires location services to be enabled in your browser, a https connection, and a valid API key.

genlog.description: Log Genmon and utility state changes to a file. Log file is in text CSV format.

filename.description: Filename for log. Full path of the file must be included (i.e. /home/pi/genmon/LogFile.csv)

genlog.title: Notifications to CSV Log

genslack.description: Send Genmon and utility state changes via Slack service

channel.description: Slack channel to which the message will be sent.

default_wait.description: The number of seconds to wait before retrying a failed message.

icon_emoji.description: Emoji that appears as the icon of the user who sent the message i.e. :red_circle:n

max_retry_time.description: Maximum number of seconds to retry a failed message before dropping the message.

notify_info.description: Send messages for information (switch state change, engine state change, exercising).

notify_pi_state.description: Send messages for Pi hardware sensor status (CPU throttling, undervoltage, etc).

notify_warning.description: Send messages for warnings (service due, fuel low).

title_link.description: Use this to make the title of the message a link i.e. link to the genmon web interface.

webhook_url.description: Full Slack Webhook URL. Retrieve from Slack custom integration configuration.

genslack.title: Notifications via Slack

gensms_voip.description: SMS Support vis VoIP using voip.ms

destination.description: Mobile number to send SMS message to. This can be any mobile number. Separate multilpe recipients with commas.

did.description: DID number for your voip.ms account to send the SMS.

password.description: VoIP.ms API password. This is NOT the account login, but rather then API password

gensms_voip.title: SMS via VoIP using voip.ms

address: The Modbus slave address in hexadecimal. This value is 9d for Evolution / Nexus, and typically 64 for industrial generators.
kwlogmax: Override the maximum size of the kW log. The default is 15MB.

displayunknown: Display the contents of additional data that appear to be associated with an unknown modbus register or a calculated value not included with the default genmon data set.
nominalfrequency: Frequency your generator is running. Either 50Hz or 60Hz. This is used by the web interface.
